subject: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery - Aurelia Tech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aurelia-tech.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery - Aurelia Tech

Hi Sarah / Rajiv —

Great to meet earlier today. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed, focused on the security review and SOC 2 package delivery milestone. Key items in this draft:

- Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
  - Target owner (Aurelia): Sarah / Rajiv (security team)
  - Target owner (Redwood): Marissa (Sales) + Vivek (Solutions)
  - Target close date: 2026-03-15
  - Dependencies: NDA signed, access to evidence repository, SOC 2 questionnaire completed
  - Deliverables: Completed questionnaire (xlsx), evidence index (pdf), redacted network diagram (png)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the internal owner for the SOC 2 questionnaire and whether your security contact (or procurement) needs any additional paperwork.
2) Can you target 2026-03-01 for submission of the completed questionnaire and evidence index? That gives us two weeks for review before the target close date.
3) I will loop in our security engineer (Aditya) and solutions lead (Vivek) to support any technical asks.

Attachments: Aurelia_SOC2_Questionnaire.xlsx (DRAFT), sample_evidence_index_template.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@aurelia-tech.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery - Aurelia Tech

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear next steps. Quick answers:

- Internal owner: Alex Turner (Security Ops) will own the questionnaire and evidence collection. I’ve CC’d him.
- Proposed timeline: Alex has proposed a target of 2026-03-03 to deliver the initial questionnaire and core evidence, which should be sufficient for your first pass. Final evidence delivery by 2026-03-10 is workable.
- Access: Alex will need a read-only link to any templates or examples you have (Drive link is fine). If there are specific evidence formats we should follow, please list them in the MAP.

Question for Redwood: will you accept redacted copies for network diagrams and screenshots? We need to ensure any produced evidence meets our confidentiality rules.

Thanks — Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of IT Security | Aurelia Tech
sarah.nguyen@aurelia-tech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery - Aurelia Tech

FYI — forwarding Aurelia’s response. They named Alex Turner as their security owner and can target 3/3 for the initial questionnaire.

Key asks for the team:
- Aditya: please review the attached questionnaire and flag any questions likely to need engineering input (configuration, key management, network segmentation).
- Vivek: coordinate with Aditya on evidence expectations and prepare our evidence index template (soc2_evidence_index.pdf).
- Neha: please prepare a short note on our redaction guidance (what we can provide as redacted screenshots/diagrams) and confirm acceptable formats.

We should aim to provide clear instructions and example artifacts so Alex’s team can submit on 3/3. I’ll send a follow-up MAP update to Aurelia with the clarified deliverables and links to our templates.

Thanks Marissa — I’ll take point on this with Aditya and Neha. Proposed internal plan:

1) By 2026-02-23: Aditya to review the questionnaire and mark Qs that require engineering artifacts or configs (expected ~12 Qs).
2) By 2026-02-24: Neha to draft redaction guidance (one-pager) and list of acceptable file formats.
3) By 2026-03-01: Deliver a filled-in questionnaire skeleton and the soc2_evidence_index.pdf for Aurelia to populate.
4) By 2026-03-10: Collect redacted evidence samples and complete index for final review.

Attachments (to Aurelia): Aurelia_SOC2_Questionnaire.xlsx (DRAFT), soc2_evidence_index.pdf, redacted_network_diagram.png

We will accept redacted diagrams/screenshots — please ask Alex to remove IP-sensitive hostnames and CIDR details; a labeled topology with abstracted subnets is fine. We can provide a short checklist for acceptable redactions.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (DEAL-2026-042)
Drive (templates): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4D
